title: Sentinel-2 L2A RGB Satellite Imagery (COG) - Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia
description: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF RGB composite from Sentinel-2 L2A satellite imagery covering Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia, derived from the Element84 Earth Search STAC catalog and processed with the Tabaqat satellite tool.
readme:
## README.md

# Sentinel-2 L2A RGB Satellite Imagery - Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia

![Riyadh Sentinel](https://i.imgur.com/8fTI5Gm.png)

# Overview
This dataset includes (Cloud Opimized Geotiff) RGB Of Sentinel-2 L2A Satellite Imagery of Riyadh Governorate, Saudi Arabia.
derived from https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1 by Tabaqat satellite tool 
which is one of Tabaqat GeoApps tools provided by https://tabaqat.net/ for a period from 1 to 14 July 2024.

# Observe it in use
You can use https://earth.gov/ghgcenter/api/raster/cog/viewer to get a quick overview to see it in action through shared URL provided here 
https://data.source.coop/tabaqat/riyadh-sentinel-rgb/Sentinel-2_Satellite_RGB_Riyadh.tif by rescaling satellite image.

# Files and Structure
- `Sentinel-2_Satellite_RGB_Riyadh.tif` - COG file of Riyadh Governorate.
- `README.md` - This file, explaining the repository.

# Data Sources: 
  This dataset was compiled by tabaqat satellite tool from https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1.

# Data Formats:
the data is provided in this format: 
- Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF : which is a regular GeoTIFF file, aimed at being hosted on a HTTP file server, with an internal organization that enables more efficient workflows on the cloud. It does this by leveraging the ability of clients issuing ​HTTP GET range requests to ask for just the parts of a file they need.for tabular data.
And you can explore more information about Cloud Optimized GeoTiff Format, its Features and Tools and Sotwares that can deal with it from here https://cogeo.org/.

# Data Access: 
Sentinel Data Downloading Process Using Tabaqat Satellite Downloader Tool is clarified in our blog post https://tabaqat-wagtail.tabaqat.net/en/resources/blogs/enhanced-satellite-data-access-and-processing-through-tabaqat-geoapps-satellite-data-downloader/. 

# Data Upload Process
Data Upload Process Steps are explained in our blog post https://blogs.tabaqat.net/en/unlocking-spatial-insights-a-guide-to-uploading-geoparquet-files-onto-source-cooperative-platform-for-enhanced-data-collaboration/ which is valid for any data format.

# Contact 
For further details about the dataset or the processing steps, you can contact us via https://platform.tabaqat.net/contact-us.
